description: MedinTux opens to a practitioner authentication screen. Click on any practitioner name from the list on the left to log in. Then use the patient search feature to find the patient 'SIMON' (last name) and open the file for SIMON Valérie (born 1970-10-19). Once you have opened her medical file (fiche patient), locate and confirm her telephone number and the city where she lives. The goal is to demonstrate you can search for a patient by name and open their file in MedinTux Manager.
